deficits.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing on the right side to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the busy road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the wide road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing points to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
Install additional street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The frames do not show the full extent of the right side to confirm the absence of all crossings.
The road is wide with multiple lanes and no central refuge island is visible.
No specific crossing point is clearly visible enough to evaluate the presence of kerb ramps.
Street lighting poles are clearly visible along the road in the frames.
